title: Roasted Red Pepper Pasta Salad with Prawns, Asparagus and Feta
changes_from_base: A blended roasted-pepper, feta and almond dressing replaces the vinaigrette, with prawns and asparagus instead of mozzarella and olives.
summary: Rotini, tender prawns, asparagus and cherry tomatoes in a creamy roasted red pepper, feta and almond dressing with a little chilli.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (1%)
ingredients.note: about 6.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: asparagus, trimmed and cut into 3 cm lengths

steps.title: Blanch asparagus and prawns
steps.text: Bring the salted water to the boil. Cook the asparagus 2 min and lift into iced water; then add the prawns off the boil for 3 min until pink and opaque (63 °C) and lift them out too. Drain both well.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in the same water, drain, rinse cold and shake dry.

steps.title: Blend the dressing
steps.text: Blend the peppers, mayonnaise, feta, almonds, lemon zest and juice, garlic, chilli and pepper until smooth and pink.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Toss the pasta, asparagus, prawns and tomatoes with the dressing and crumble over the remaining feta.

tips: Poach the prawns off the boil so they stay tender.
Blend the dressing very smooth for an even pink coat.
Swap the asparagus for green beans out of season.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 1 day; loosen with a splash of water or oil and check the seasoning before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
